📺 Tacoma FD (2019–2023)

Tacoma FD follows a group of firefighters working at a fire station in Tacoma, Washington, where the constant rainy weather means they spend more time finding ways to entertain themselves than actually fighting fires. Led by Chief Terry McConky and Captain Eddie Penisi, the crew turns everyday station life into a series of hilarious competitions, outrageous pranks, awkward situations, and ridiculous challenges. Despite their childish behavior and constant disagreements, the firefighters share a strong friendship and always come together when their community needs them. Starring Kevin Heffernan and Steve Lemme, the series delivers laugh-out-loud workplace comedy, unforgettable characters, and plenty of chaotic moments while celebrating teamwork, friendship, and the unpredictable lives of first responders.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22–30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Kevin Heffernan & Steve Lemme
